name: Kansas

agency.name: Kansas Department of Revenue, Division of Vehicles (through the county treasurers)

taxAgency.name: Kansas Department of Revenue, Division of Taxation

gaps: Kansas vehicles pay a county personal property tax with every registration, computed from the vehicle's value class and the local mill levy; it is not computable from the form, so it is shown without an amount.

Local sales tax depends on the city and special districts of the buyer's address (and, on a private sale, the highest of the sale location and the registration address). Only the countywide rates of Johnson County (1.475%) and Sedgwick County (1%) are prefilled; the Department of Revenue rate booklet could not be reached for this release, so for any other place type the local rate.
At purchase the registration and property tax are prorated to the owner's staggered renewal month; the calculator shows a full year.
County treasurers may add a facility fee of up to $5 per registration ($2.50 in a county with one tag office); it is shown as a range.
Kansas law sets no documentary fee cap that was found for this release; type the dealer's fee.
The K.S.A. 8-143 fees for hybrid, plug-in hybrid and electric cars ($70, $100 and $165) are read from the 2026 Kansas Statutes; their effective date was not printed on the statute page read.

summary.docFeeNote: No cap found in Kansas law for this release; administrative fees charged by the dealer are subject to sales tax.
summary.inspectionWhere: No periodic inspection; a used vehicle titled in another state needs a one-time Kansas Highway Patrol VIN check (minimum $20) before titling.

counties.name: Any other Kansas county (type your local rate)

singular: Kansas taxes a car at the 6.5% state rate plus local sales tax, on the price after the trade-in, and the dealer's administrative fee is part of the taxed amount [pub1526].
A car bought from a private seller is taxed too: the buyer pays the sales tax to the county treasurer when registering it [pub1526].
Registration is a flat $30 a year for a car of 4,500 lb or less and $40 above, but hybrids pay $70, plug-in hybrids $100 and electric cars $165 [ksa-8-143].
Every registration and renewal also carries a $5 service fee, and the county may add up to $5 more [ksa-8-145d].
The county treasurer collects the vehicle's personal property tax at the time of registration [titlenew].
A used car titled in another state must pass a Highway Patrol VIN check, charged $20 per hour with a $20 minimum, before it gets a Kansas title [ksa-8-116a].
Sedgwick County lists a $10.50 title and tag fee and a $4 modernization fee, and its countywide sales tax brings the rate to 7.5% [sedgwick-fees].

pub1526.name: Kansas Department of Revenue, Pub. KS-1526 Business Taxes for Motor Vehicle Transactions (Rev. 7-29-25; read through the Internet Archive copy of 2026-02-26, ksrevenue.gov unreachable)
pub1526.quote: Sales tax is due at the 7.5% Anytown sales tax rate on $27,910: $26,500 + $385 + $75 + $950 ... charge sales tax on the net price or trade difference — after the trade-in allowance ... the purchaser is required to pay the sales tax due to the County Treasurer

ksa-8-143.name: 2026 Kansas Statutes, K.S.A. 8-143, annual registration fees
ksa-8-143.quote: (A) For those having a gross weight of 4,500 pounds or less, $30; (B) for those having a gross weight of more than 4,500 pounds, $40; (C) ... electric hybrid vehicles, $70; (D) ... plug-in electric hybrid vehicles, $100; and (E) ... all-electric vehicles, $165

ksa-8-135.name: 2026 Kansas Statutes, K.S.A. 8-135, certificate of title
ksa-8-135.quote: The fee for each original certificate of title shall be $10 in addition to the fee for registration of such vehicle

ksa-8-145d.name: 2026 Kansas Statutes, K.S.A. 8-145d, service fee
ksa-8-145d.quote: any applicant for vehicle registration or renewal thereof for registration shall pay a service fee in the amount of $5 ... (1) In an amount not to exceed $5 per vehicle registration ... in a county with multiple vehicle registration facilities

ksa-8-116a.name: 2026 Kansas Statutes, K.S.A. 8-116a, VIN check by the Highway Patrol
ksa-8-116a.quote: Any person making application for any original Kansas title for a used vehicle that ... is titled in another jurisdiction ... shall have such vehicle checked ... A charge of $20 per hour or part thereof, with a minimum charge of $20

titlenew.name: Kansas Division of Vehicles, Titling a New Vehicle (read through the Internet Archive copy of 2026-09-23)
titlenew.quote: Property tax must be paid at the time of registration unless applying for a temporary plate.

sedgwick-fees.name: Sedgwick County Tag Office, Fees and Payment (read through the Internet Archive copy of 2026-05-10)
sedgwick-fees.quote: Title and Tag Fee is $10.50. Modernization Fee is $4.00. ... The rate in Sedgwick County is 7.5 percent. ... your fees will be the same as a new tag minus the 50¢ plate fee.

jo-rate.name: City of Roeland Park, Sales Tax Rates (Johnson County components)
jo-rate.quote: State of Kansas 6.500% ... Johnson County General Sales Tax 0.500% ... Stormwater 0.100% ... Public Safety Sales Tax 1 0.250% ... Public Safety Sales Tax 2 0.250% ... Courthouse 0.250% ... Research Triangle 0.125%

ksa-8-145.name: 2026 Kansas Statutes, K.S.A. 8-145, collection of fees and disposition
ksa-8-145.quote: Four dollars of each division of vehicles modernization surcharge collected and remitted to the secretary of revenue, shall be remitted to the state treasurer who shall credit such $4 to the state highway fund.
